1.w: A Song of the Ascents. Of David. I was glad at the saying to me, “Let us go [to] the house of YHWH.”

2.w: Our feet have been standing within your gates, O Jerusalem!

3.w: Jerusalem is built up as a city joined to itself together;

4.w: there the tribes go up, the tribes of YAH, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of YHWH.

5.w: For there sit the thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

6.w: Ask for the peace of Jerusalem: “May they prosper, those loving you!

7.w: May there be peace within your wall, prosperity within your citadels!”

8.w: For the sake of my brothers and my companions let me now say: “Peace [be] within you!”

9.w: For the sake of the house of YHWH our God I will seek good for you.
